decisions.reason: The power-board production files and BOM are referenced only as an existing comparison and as the incorrectly copied spreadsheet; the client requests changes solely to the sensor-board package.
Generating sensor-board manufacturing files does not change the required connector pin labels or their placement.
The request for a correct sensor-board BOM and production files does not alter component availability, sourcing, or fallback constraints.
The requested Gerbers, drill files, and positions file must represent the sensor-board design but do not modify its mechanical layout requirements.
The sensor-board production-package request does not change board-chain order, power rails, connectors, or distribution behavior.
The source requests production files for the sensor board only and does not alter any main-board mechanical-layout requirement.
The source does not add, remove, or change any main-board connector or connector-architecture requirement.
The manufacturing-file request does not change the monitored rails, monitor IC, measurement coverage, or channel allocation.
Although the production files must reflect the existing sensor-board connectors, the source does not modify their inventory, types, pinouts, or count.
The source does not change sensor logic levels, level-shifter omission, footprint policy, or future adapter-board handling.
The production-package request does not alter the SPS30 SEL connection or its required I2C operating mode.
The reference to other boards and the copied power-board BOM does not change any power-board mechanical-layout constraint.
